name: Macaroni-Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Grape & Strawberry Fruit Salad

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 medium zucchini squash
½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
⅓ lb red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a small bowl, and set aside for later use.

Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on a baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until softened, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the zucchini is baking, trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Place in a medium bowl.
Halve grapes. Add to the bowl with the strawberries, stir to combine the fruit salad, and set aside.
When the pasta is done, return the pan to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chopped zucchini and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 2 minutes.
Add flour to the pan and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until zucchini is well coated, about 30 seconds.
Slowly pour milk into the pan, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes more.
Add cheese and spices to the pan. Continue whisking until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, about 1 minute. Add cooked pasta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
salt
black pepper
⅛ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Divide zucchini boats between plates, then fill with macaroni and cheese. Serve with fruit salad on the side and enjoy!
